description: This file defines the QUIC context and configuration parameters used in the Chromium project, including supported versions, timeouts, and migration settings for QUIC connections.

classes.name: QuicParams
classes.description: Structure containing configuration options and experimental settings for QUIC.

classes.name: QuicContext
classes.description: Class managing shared QUIC connection variables and helper interfaces.

methods.name: DefaultSupportedQuicVersions
methods.description: Returns the default supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: ObsoleteQuicVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of obsolete QUIC versions that are supported but not recommended for use.

methods.name: AllSupportedQuicVersions
methods.description: Returns all supported QUIC versions excluding obsolete ones.

methods.name: InitializeQuicConfig
methods.description: Initializes and returns a QuicConfig object based on provided parameters.
